svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How the action works
svg.desc: How the action works. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: Weekly cron to Fetch badges (uses: @v1); badges.json to Fetch badges (every page); Fetch badges to Select badges; Select badges to Categorize; Categorize to README section (output: readme or both); Categorize to SVG cards (output: svg or both); images.credly.com to SVG cards (each image); Writes into your checkout to Commit and push (commit: true); Writes into your checkout to Your commit step (commit: false); Commit and push to Your profile README (git push); Your commit step to Your profile README (git push).

text.tspan: One Python script in a composite action. No token; Pillow is installed only for the SVG cards.
